title: 1in8b (1 in 8 Billion)
tagline: A browser life simulator with solo and two-player modes, featuring real-time voice chat powered by Agora WebRTC.
description: Learn how 1in8b (1 in 8 Billion), an open-source browser life simulator, implements private two-player rooms and Agora WebRTC voice chat. Follow the TypeScript architecture, room authorization, audio lifecycle, local setup, and Cloudflare Workers self-hosting steps.
author: 0xRe

media.title: 1in8b (1 in 8 Billion)
media.summary: Explore a two-player life simulator and learn how its private rooms, shared decisions, and Agora WebRTC voice chat work.
media.thumbnailAlt: Illustrated two-player cover with two pixel-art characters and the words A life, together.
media.demoNote: Self-hosted voice needs your own Agora App ID and App Certificate. Two players and microphone access are required for calls; solo play and room text chat work without Agora keys.
